title: Detailed ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cone -->
  <polygon points="35,55 65,55 55,95 45,95" fill="#D4923A"/>
  <polygon points="35,55 65,55 55,95 45,95" fill="#E8A84C" opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="60" x2="62" y2="60" stroke="#C07828" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="67" x2="60" y2="67" stroke="#C07828" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="74" x2="58" y2="74" stroke="#C07828" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="81" x2="56" y2="81" stroke="#C07828" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="88" x2="54" y2="88" stroke="#C07828" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- cone diagonal texture -->
  <line x1="40" y1="58" x2="48" y2="90" stroke="#C07828" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="58" x2="52" y2="90" stroke="#C07828" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- strawberry scoop -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="17" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="17" fill="#FF8FA8" opacity="0.4"/>
  <!-- scoop shading -->
  <path d="M36,45 Q50,55 64,45" fill="none" stroke="#E85070" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- vanilla scoop -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="32" r="13" fill="#FFF0C8"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="32" r="13" fill="#FFFAE0" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- chocolate scoop -->
  <circle cx="56" cy="28" r="12" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="28" r="12" fill="#A0714E" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- topping drizzle -->
  <path d="M44,19 Q50,15 56,19 Q60,22 62,28" fill="none" stroke="#FF4466" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M40,24 Q38,20 42,18" fill="none" stroke="#FF4466" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- sprinkles on vanilla -->
  <rect x="40" y="28" width="4" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#FF3366" transform="rotate(30 42 29)"/>
  <rect x="47" y="30" width="4" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#44DD88" transform="rotate(-20 49 31)"/>
  <rect x="42" y="35" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#FFCC00" transform="rotate(60 44 36)"/>
  <rect x="48" y="24" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#4488FF" transform="rotate(10 50 25)"/>

  <!-- sprinkles on strawberry -->
  <rect x="44" y="48" width="4" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#FFCC00" transform="rotate(45 46 49)"/>
  <rect x="54" y="46" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#44DD88" transform="rotate(-30 56 47)"/>
  <rect x="48" y="52" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#4488FF" transform="rotate(15 50 53)"/>

  <!-- cherry on top -->
  <circle cx="56" cy="17" r="4" fill="#FF2244"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="17" r="4" fill="#FF4466" opacity="0.4"/>
  <path d="M56,13 Q60,8 64,6" fill="none" stroke="#33AA55" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- wafer stick -->
  <rect x="68" y="20" width="3" height="18" rx="1" fill="#E8C880" transform="rotate(15 69 29)"/>
  <line x1="68.5" y1="24" x2="71" y2="24" stroke="#C8A860" stroke-width="0.8" transform="rotate(15 69 29)"/>
  <line x1="68.5" y1="29" x2="71" y2="29" stroke="#C8A860" stroke-width="0.8" transform="rotate(15 69 29)"/>
  <line x1="68.5" y1="34" x2="71" y2="34" stroke="#C8A860" stroke-width="0.8" transform="rotate(15 69 29)"/>
</svg>
